decisions.evidence: Taken together, the six comparisons are consistent with option (B): the query repeatedly matches or exceeds the mutagenic neighbors on ring count, aromatic ring count, and in several cases lower QED or higher charge-related features, while the three non-mutagenic neighbors do not pull it strongly enough in the opposite direction. The most recurring pattern is a compact, highly aromatic, low-sp3 framework with high ring content and related physicochemical properties, so the overall prediction is mutagenic.
